# Provenance of the tables in this directory

**These results pre-date the leakage fix.** They were generated by the
pipeline as it stood before two methodology corrections landed:

| # | Issue | Fix |
|---|-------|-----|
| 1 | The controlled-injection indicator pool (IPs, sighting timestamps, synthetic confidence, benign-noise pool) was built from the **entire** labelled frame, test rows included — so test-split labels could influence test-split features. A flow could also be flagged by its own sighting when its timestamp sat exactly on a poll boundary. | `scripts/_common.py` (`split_first`, `get_sightings(eligible=...)`), `src/cti_pipeline/enrich.py` (strict poll-boundary read). See `docs/METHODOLOGY.md` §4.4. |
| 2 | The `live_feeds_only` ablation variant dropped all six CTI columns, so its metrics are a **duplicate of `traffic_only`** instead of a measurement of what live feeds contribute. | `scripts/run_e2_ablation.py::variant_designs`. |

Consequently every figure here is an **upper bound** produced by the pre-fix
pipeline, and the `live_feeds_only` rows do not measure what their name says.

## Regenerating

```bash
python tests/test_leakage.py        # must pass 10/10 before any run
python deploy/test_hardening.py     # must pass 51/51
powershell -File run_all.ps1        # or the manual sequence in docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md
```

When `results/tables/` has been regenerated with the fixed pipeline, delete
this file and remove the provenance notices from `README.md` and
`docs/RESULTS.md`.
